verdict.rationale: Seller tax reporting is a fair question for a platform-payments product, but nothing in the evidence covers 1099-K threshold tracking, form generation, delivery, filing, or a corrections workflow. The only nearby item is Adyen-generated bookkeeping and reconciliation reports, which is an adjacent feature, not tax reporting.
